F2-L08.intro: From “I” to “he” and “she”: read profile cards aloud and talk about other people — اِسْمُهُ / اِسْمُهَا، يَسْكُنُ / تَسْكُنُ، هِوَايَتُهُ / هِوَايَتُهَا — then compare profiles and choose a pen-pal.

roleplays.setting: Reading a pen-pal card with a friend
roleplays.title: Layla’s card

tasks.task: Card: Rabat, Morocco. Say where she lives.
tasks.en: She lives in Rabat, in Morocco.

tasks.task: ASK what her hobby is (your friend then answers).
Answer the unexpected question, with a reason.
tasks.en: Yes, because she likes drawing, like me.

tasks.model: هٰذَا يُوسُفُ؛ عُمْرُهُ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً، وَهُوَ أُرْدُنِيٌّ.
tasks.en: This is Yusuf; he is fifteen, and he is Jordanian.

tasks.task: Poster: lives in Leeds · Arabic + English.
tasks.model: يَسْكُنُ فِي لِيدْز، وَيَتَكَلَّمُ العَرَبِيَّةَ وَالإِنْجِلِيزِيَّةَ.
tasks.en: He lives in Leeds, and he speaks Arabic and English.

tasks.model: فِي وَقْتِ الفَرَاغِ يَسْبَحُ؛ فَهِوَايَتُهُ السِّبَاحَةُ.
tasks.en: In his free time he swims; his hobby is swimming.

tasks.task: ASK to check that his favourite subject is maths (the teacher then answers).
Answer the unexpected question, with a reason.
tasks.model: مَادَّتِي المُفَضَّلَةُ العَرَبِيَّةُ، لِأَنَّهَا جَمِيلَةٌ وَمُمْتِعَةٌ.
tasks.en: My favourite subject is Arabic, because it is beautiful and fun.

tasks.task: Card: Hana · girl · Egyptian · 13 · reading. Describe her.
tasks.model: هَنَاءُ بِنْتٌ مِصْرِيَّةٌ، عُمْرُهَا ثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً، وَهِوَايَتُهَا القِرَاءَةُ.
tasks.en: Hana is an Egyptian girl; she is thirteen, and her hobby is reading.

tasks.task: Card: Karim · boy · Lebanese · 14 · football. Describe him.
tasks.model: كَرِيمٌ وَلَدٌ لُبْنَانِيٌّ، عُمْرُهُ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً، وَهِوَايَتُهُ كُرَةُ القَدَمِ.
tasks.en: Karim is a Lebanese boy; he is fourteen, and his hobby is football.

tasks.task: Choose one and give a reason.
tasks.help: أَخْتَارُ … لِأَنَّ هِوَايَتَهُ / هِوَايَتَهَا مِثْلُ هِوَايَتِي …
tasks.model: أَخْتَارُ كَرِيمًا، لِأَنَّ هِوَايَتَهُ مِثْلُ هِوَايَتِي؛ فَأَنَا أُحِبُّ كُرَةَ القَدَمِ أَيْضًا.
tasks.en: I choose Karim, because his hobby is like mine; I love football too.

tasks.examiner: … لَا، هُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ العَرَبِيَّةَ وَالفَرَنْسِيَّةَ فَقَطْ.
tasks.task: ASK if Karim speaks English (the coordinator then answers).
Answer the unexpected question, in order.
tasks.model: أَكْتُبُ اسْمِي وَعُمْرِي وَمَكَانَ سَكَنِي، ثُمَّ هِوَايَتِي وَمَادَّتِي المُفَضَّلَةَ.
tasks.en: I write my name, age and where I live, then my hobby and favourite subject.

conversation.qen: Describe your (male) friend: name, age and hobby.
conversation.model: صَدِيقِي اسْمُهُ عَلِيٌّ، عُمْرُهُ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً، وَهِوَايَتُهُ السِّبَاحَةُ.
conversation.en: My friend is called Ali; he is fourteen, and his hobby is swimming.

conversation.qen: Describe your (female) friend the same way.
conversation.model: صَدِيقَتِي اسْمُهَا زَيْنَبُ، عُمْرُهَا ثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً، وَهِوَايَتُهَا الطَّبْخُ.
conversation.en: My friend is called Zaynab; she is thirteen, and her hobby is cooking.

conversation.qen: What do you do in your free time?
conversation.model: فِي وَقْتِ الفَرَاغِ أَقْرَأُ وَأَلْعَبُ كُرَةَ السَّلَّةِ.
conversation.en: In my free time I read and play basketball.

conversation.qen: What is the difference between “hiwāyatuhu” and “hiwāyatuhā”?
conversation.en: “Hiwāyatuhu” is for a boy (his hobby), and “hiwāyatuhā” for a girl (her hobby).

conversation.q: قَدِّمْ بِطَاقَةً شَخْصِيَّةً لِشَخْصٍ مَشْهُورٍ تُحِبُّهُ.
conversation.qen: Present a profile of a famous person you like.
conversation.starter: هُوَ / هِيَ … ، يَسْكُنُ / تَسْكُنُ فِي … ، وَيَتَكَلَّمُ / تَتَكَلَّمُ … ، وَهِوَايَتُهُ / هِوَايَتُهَا …
conversation.model: هُوَ لَاعِبُ كُرَةِ قَدَمٍ مِصْرِيٌّ، يَسْكُنُ فِي إِنْجِلْتِرَا، وَيَتَكَلَّمُ العَرَبِيَّةَ وَالإِنْجِلِيزِيَّةَ، وَهِوَايَتُهُ الرِّيَاضَةُ طَبْعًا!
conversation.en: He is an Egyptian footballer; he lives in England, speaks Arabic and English, and his hobby is sport, of course!

conversation.q: قَارِنْ بَيْنَ هِوَايَتِكَ وَهِوَايَةِ أَخِيكَ أَوْ أُخْتِكَ.
conversation.qen: Compare your hobby with your brother’s or sister’s.
conversation.model: هِوَايَتِي الرَّسْمُ، وَلٰكِنَّ هِوَايَةَ أَخِي كُرَةُ القَدَمِ؛ هُوَ يُحِبُّ الرِّيَاضَةَ، وَأَنَا أُحِبُّ الفَنَّ.
conversation.en: My hobby is drawing, but my brother’s hobby is football; he loves sport, and I love art.

conversation.q: لِمَاذَا نَقْرَأُ البِطَاقَةَ الشَّخْصِيَّةَ بِسُرْعَةٍ أَوَّلًا؟
conversation.qen: Why do we skim a profile card first?
conversation.model: نَقْرَؤُهَا بِسُرْعَةٍ لِنَجِدَ المَعْلُومَاتِ المُهِمَّةَ، مِثْلَ الاِسْمِ وَالعُمْرِ وَالمَدِينَةِ، ثُمَّ نَقْرَأُ التَّفَاصِيلَ.
conversation.en: We skim it to find the important information, like name, age and city, then we read the details.

conversation.q: مَا الهِوَايَةُ الَّتِي تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَبْدَأَهَا؟ وَلِمَاذَا؟
conversation.qen: Which hobby do you want to start, and why?
conversation.model: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَبْدَأَ رُكُوبَ الخَيْلِ، لِأَنَّهُ رِيَاضَةٌ جَمِيلَةٌ وَمُفِيدَةٌ.
conversation.en: I want to start horse riding, because it is a beautiful and useful sport.
